Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We look forward to receiving your response on how you wish to proceed.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have linked the adjustment to specific inputs and their cost shares—it sounds like recovering those costs is your central concern. We want pricing that supports our long-standing partnership and fairly reflects the pressures you face. How can we reconcile the different index periods to establish a consistent basis for the adjustment?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the decrease in the PPI-C241 index and noted your increased volume forecast, which allows us to adjust our pricing accordingly. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.

We present an offer with a price of €371.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. However, a 90-day payment term significantly increases capital costs; we must therefore maintain our standard 30-day terms to facilitate this price reduction. Consequently, we propose a revised price of €367.43 per unit, subject to 30 days net payment. This alternative package, at our standard terms, comprises a price of €367.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

It sounds like financing costs are a distinct concern, because you link your further price reduction directly to faster payment. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and want a stable partnership that recognises genuine cost pressures. How can we address that financing concern while grounding the price adjustment in verified cost movements?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have incorporated the published copper movement while keeping your calculation private—it sounds like recognising your cost pressures without opening your books is important. We respect that boundary and want a sustainable agreement for our long-standing partnership. How can payment timing help us address those pressures and agree a fair price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). Our recent orders for Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole were at 348.32 per 1 (po:4500014350-20, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014474-10). What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 361.33 per unit, 30 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our margin and our limits stay internal, and our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Returning to our standard 30-day payment terms eliminates additional financing costs, allowing us to reduce the price. Consequently, we propose a revised price of €365.67 per unit, which represents a fair agreement under the current cost pressures.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer is a price of €365.67 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
